# LaunchPod Media

> LaunchPod Media builds branded podcasts for businesses. It handles the strategy, branding, content pipeline and distribution that give a show its first six months of momentum, then offers add-on services ("Pods") for advertising, video, social and web content. Its site is https://www.launchpodmedia.com.

Every page listed here serves its text as plain HTML and can be read without running JavaScript.

## Services

- [Launch](https://www.launchpodmedia.com/launch): The Launch system for starting a podcast that builds authority, drives conversations, and grows with the business.
- [Pods](https://www.launchpodmedia.com/pods): Modular services. Start with the essentials, then add what moves the needle.
- [Boost Pod](https://www.launchpodmedia.com/boost-pod): Strategic podcast advertising with native ads across Meta, TikTok and Instagram.
- [Production Pod](https://www.launchpodmedia.com/production-pod): Video production with color grading, animation, titling and platform-native formats, recorded in one of its 30+ studios, the client's space, or remotely.
- [Social Pod](https://www.launchpodmedia.com/social-pod): Turns long-form podcast content into platform-ready social media assets.
- [Web Pod](https://www.launchpodmedia.com/web-pod): Turns a podcast into searchable web content: blog posts, transcripts, embedded players and videos, optimized for Google and AI search.
- [Webicast](https://www.launchpodmedia.com/webicast): Turns a webinar recording the client has already run into a slate of podcast episodes. Priced monthly by episode count.
- [Postcast](https://www.launchpodmedia.com/postcast): Turns a client's best-performing written content into a produced podcast episode.
